modules.module_title: Carry out the process of vent sexing for DOC

pcs.pc_description: hold the chick in one hand, with chick’s rear facing towards individual, over an area, that can be cleaned easily
press gently on the abdomen, then squeeze its vent
clear the faeces of the vent
spread the vent carefully so that the tissue just inside the vent is visible
segregate the chicks with a small bump as male
segregate the chicks with no visible bulge or just a slight indentation as female
place males in one box and females in another box
place chicks in a third box if uncertain and repeat the sexing process

modules.module_title: Carry out the process of feather sexing for DOC

pcs.pc_description: examine visually the chicks wing/feathers to determine its sex
segregate the chick as female if it shows fast feathering
segregate the chick as male if it shows slow feathering
segregate the chick as male if in case, the covert feathers are longer than the primary feathers ( super slow feathering)
place males in one box and females in another box
repeat the sexing process in case of any uncertainity
segregate waste into different categories and dispose them accordingly
deposit recyclable and reusable material at the identified location

modules.module_title: Assess the DOC based on various parameters

pcs.pc_description: prepare the chicks for assessment in a conducive environment
lay down the chick on its back and observe the quickness of its turning back up
observe the responsiveness of eyes of the DOC
assess the standing ability of the chick when placed upright
observe the skin colour near the naval
assess the appearance of chicks for clean and dry feathers
observe the behavioural response of chicks to stimuli such as light and other movements of human hands
observe the beaks of chicks for any deformity or spots
observe the posture of the chicks and discard the chicks with weakness in the legs
grade the chick to be of good quality based on various parameters
segregate the chicks with any deformity or red spots on the beak, as poor quality
remove any chicks with injuries or any other deformities in whole body
segregate waste into different categories and dispose them appropriately
